༄༅/ /dag yig blo gsar gzhon nu dga' byed ces bya ba bzhugs/

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dag yig blo gsar gzhon nu dga' byed ces bya ba bzhugs/

na mo mañdzu shrī ye/ dngos grub 'byung gnas rje btsun 'phags ma sgrol/ /'chi med tshe yi dpal ster rnam par rgyal/ /tshig gi mchog sbyin dbyangs can lha mo'i zhabs/ /dus gnas byang chub bar du gtsug gis bsten/ /yig sde brgyas par gzhan du bshad zin kyang*/ /'dir yang don gnyer can gyis bskul ba'i ngor/ /gsar bu dag la go sla'i tshul gyis dang*/ /cung zad rtogs dka' thor bu bsdus te bshad/ /pa bkar logs bkar da dkar kha dog dkar/ /ra rka chu'i rka da dka' mi nus dka'/ /ba bka' bka' lung ro bska ba sa'i bska/ /ba bkal khal bkal khral bkal skud pa bkal/ /sa skal tho bskal bskal ba ba sa'i bskal/ /ra rkan rkan phug pa bkan gyen du bkan/ ba sa'i bskos ni dpon du bskos pa ste/ /ba ra'i brkos ni sa sogs brkos pa'i ming*/ /sa skur skur 'debs nor bskur ba sa'i bskur/ /ba sa'i bskus ni tshon sogs bskus pa'i ming*/ /ba 'og ra brku ma byin len pa'o/ /da dkrol rol mo brdung ba'i ming yin te/ /ba bkrol bcings pa bkrol ba'i ming du 'dod/ /sa skug gab pa la lkug smra mi shes/ /da dku sta zur sa sku bla ma'i sku/ /ra rku rkun po brkus zin ba ra'i brkus/ /ba bkum bsad pa lag bskum ba sa'i bskum/ /ba bkang snod bkang thugs bskang ba sa'i bskang*/ /ba ra'i brkyangs ni rkang ba sogs brkyang ba/ /ba sa'i bskyangs ni drin gyis bskyangs pa'o/ /ba bkon gnod lan dkon rnyed dka'i dkon/ /ba sa'i bskon ni gos sogs bskon pa'i ming*/ /ba bkra mdog sogs bkra dang bkra shis te/ /sa btags skra ni mgo yi skra yin no/ /ba bkrag 'od che sa skrag 'jigs pa'i ming*/ /da dkyil dbus yin sa skyil chu skyil sogs/ /ba bkren nor med sa skran nad kyi ming*/ /ba bka'i bkyon ni bka' bkyon gnang ba ste/ /ba sa'i bskyon ni rta la bskyon pa'o/ /ma mkhur mkhur tshos 'a 'khur 'khur bo 'khur/

/da dga' sems dga' ra rga na tshod rga/ /sa sga rta sga sman lga la btags lga/ /da dgo ri dwags sa sgo khang ba'i sgo/ /ba bgo gos gon bka' bsgo ba sa'i bsgo/ /'a 'go nad 'go thog ma'i 'go ba ste/ /ma mgo lus kyi mgo sogs rtse mo'i don/ /ba bgro bgro gleng sa sgro bya sogs sgro/ /ba bgos bgos skal sa sgos sgos su bkar/ /ba 'og sa bsgos bag chags bsgos pa'o/ /sa sgar dmag sgar da dgar zur du dgar/ /da dgang gnod dgang ba 'og sa btags bsgang*/ /bya ba'i gzhung ste sa sgang mtho ba'i ming*/ /ba bgam tshod len sa sgam shing sgam zab/ /ra rgyu rgyu rkyen nang khrol rgyu ma ste/ /sa sgyu sgyu ma mkhan dang g.yo sgyu'i sgyu/ /ra rgyab lus rgyab rgyob cig ces pa ste/ /ba ra'i brgyab ni dbyug pas brgyab zin ming*/ /sa sgyug sgyug mo ra rgyugs mgyogs par 'gro/ /ba bgag lam bkag mna' bsgag ba sa'i bsgag /da dgrol mdud lhod sa sgrol 'jigs las sgrol/ /ba bgres rgas po rigs bsgre ba sa'i bsgres/ /ra rgod phyi dro'am yang na da yi dgongs/ /phyi dro'am shes pa'i zhe sar 'dod pa yin/ /ma mgul mgrin pa 'a 'gul g.yo zhing 'gul/ /ma mnga' yod pa sa snga dus kyi snga/ /la lnga grangs dang ra rnga brdung bya'i rnga/ /sa sngo kha dog ra rngo nad yin te/ /da dngo gri so bsngo bya ba sa'i bsngo/ /ma mngar ro mngar da dngar tshar du dngar/ /da dngul rin chen ra rngul lus kyi chu/ /sa sngags gsang sngags ma mngags pho nya btang*/ /ba bcal rin bcal gcal bkram ga yi gcal/ /ga gci rtug pa la lci ljid lci ba/ /ma mchu kha mchu 'a 'chu chu sogs 'chu/ /ma mchor mdzes pa 'a 'chor bya ba 'chor/ /ga gnyen nye du ma mnyen reg bya 'jam/ /ba sa'i bsnyen ni nye ba'i don du 'dod/ /ga gnyan sa bdag ma mnyan nyan bya'i sgra/ /sa snyan snyan pa gzugs brnyan ba ra'i brnyan/ /sa snyam yid bsam ma mnyam mtshungs pa'i mnyam/ /sa snyed mang po ra rnyed gsar du rnyed/

/ma mnyed ko ba la sogs mnyed pa'i ming*/ /sa snyes sngas la snyes pa'o ba ra'i brnyes/ /go 'phang thob pa sogs kyi ming yin no/ /ga gnyug dben pa sa snyug shing gi snyug /ra rnying rnying ba sa snying nang khrol snying/ /ra rnyi 'dzin byed sa snyi sra min snyi/ /sa snyad snyad 'dogs bshad pa ba sa'i bsnyad/ /ga gtar khrag gtar byi dor ba sa'i bstar/ /ga gtan rgyun du sa stan gdan gyi ming*/ ba 'og sa bstan chos bstan rgyal ba'i bstan/ /bla ma bsten dang ba 'og ra brtan ni/ /mi 'gyur brtan pa nyid du 'dod pa yin/ /ra rten mchod rten la sogs rten gyi ming*/ /ba 'og ra brten de la brten pa'o/ /ga gtogs der gtogs ba btogs spu btogs pa/ /ra rtogs don rtogs la ltogs bkres pa'i ming*/ /yang na ra rtog rnam rtog rtog pa'o/ /ga gtam tshig yin yang na gang ba'i gtams/ /ba la'i bltams ni sku 'khrungs bltams par 'dod/ /ra rtag mi 'jig sa stag gcan gzan te/ /ba btags thag btags brtag dpyad ba ra'i brtag /la ltag gnya' ltag ra rtod phur bu rtod/ /sa stod lus stod bstod bsngags ba sa'i bstod/ /ba btod srol btod ga gtod dmigs pa gtod/ /ga gtun gtun bu thugs bstan ba sa'i bstun/ /ga gter mdzod yin sa ster gzhan la ster/ /ba bcud zhabs btud ga gtubs dum bur gtubs/ sa ste'u mtshon char rte'u rta yi bu/ /ra rta dud 'gro lta byed la lta'o/ /mig gis bltas pa gzhan la rag las bltos/ /ba 'phul yin te ltos shig bas 'phul med/ /ga gtos khyon yin rgyas pa ba ra'i brtas/ /la ltas snga rtags stes dbang sa stes yin/ /gtol med ga gtol rnag brtol ba ra'i brtol/ /ra rting rting ba ga gting chu yi gting*/ /ba btags phye btags ming btags sgro btags so/ /ra rtags mtshon byed sgrub byed rtags kyang yin/ /ga gtong sbyin gtong sa stong grangs kyi mig /la ltong mda'i ltong ba btul dgra sogs btul/

/ga gtul spos gtul dud pa gtul ba'o/ /ra rtab tsab tsab byin pa ba sa'i bltabs/ /sa stobs mthu yin ba btab sa bon btab/ /ba la'i bltab ni gos sogs bltab pa'o/ /rtog rkyang rtse mo ga gtog se gol gtog /ma mthu nus pa 'a 'thu me tog 'thu/ /'a 'thur 'thur du ma mthur mthur mda'i ming*/ /ga gda' yod pa ba bda' kha zas zhim/ /ba 'og ra brda lag ba'i brda sogs byed/ /ba bdug spos yin sa sdug yid du 'ong*/ /ga gdug gnod byed 'bubs pa'i gdugs kyang yin/ /ra rdug thabs rdug sdug bsngal sa sdug yin/ /ga gdab gsol gdab sa bon gdab pa ste/ /ba ra'i brdab ni sa la brdabs pa'o/ /ra rdeg ba 'og brdeg ni rim bzhin du/ /rdeg par byed dang brdeg par byas pa'o/ /ba bteg gyon bteg sa stegs stegs bu'i stegs/ /ga gdung gdung ma ra rdung rnga sogs rdung*/ /ba bdung gzhu bdung sa sdod mi 'gul sdod/ /ba bde bde legs sa sde sde ba'o/ /ra rdo rdo nyid sa sdo do sngo ba/ /ba bdo rgyas pa'am dar ba'i ming du 'dod/ /ra rdul rdul phran ga gdul gdul bya'i ming*/ /'a 'dud gus pa ma mdud mdud pa'o/ /'a 'dun bsam pa ma mdun lus kyi mdun/ /'a 'don chos 'don phyi ru 'don pa ste/ /ga gdon gnod byed la ldon lan smra ba/ /'a 'dab nye 'dabs lo 'dab pad 'dab sogs/ /la ldab bskyar ldab ra rdob pheg rdob yin/ /ma mdongs bya sgro la ldongs long ba ste/ /'a 'dong 'gro ba 'a 'dur 'dur rgyug byed/ /la yi ldur ni ldur ldur byed pa'o/ /ga gdan stan yin la ldan yod pa'i ming*/ /sa snod snod spyad ga gnod mi phan gnod/ /ga gnag mdog gnag ra rnag khrag rul ming*/ ba ra'i brnag ni sems la bsams pa'i don/ /ga gnang byin pa sa snang blo la snang*/ /ma mnan 'og mnan mang btang ba sa'i bsnan/ /ba ra'i brnan ni nges bzung nan tan ming*/ /sa sna dri 'dzin ra rna sgra 'dzin te/ /ga gna' thog ma mna' byas ma yi mna'/

/ma mno yid sems ra rno rtse mo rno/ /ga gnad gnad don lus bsnad ba sa'i bsnad/ /ma mnabs gos gyon kha cig ba banabs zer/ /sa snabs sna yi snabs dang ngar snabs so/ /ra rnams mang bo ga gnam nam mkha'i ming*/ /ba 'og sa bsnams phyag tu bsnams pa'o/ /ga gnangs sang yin gnang sbyin nyid kyang ste/ /ba ra'i brnangs ni zas kyis brnangs pa'o/ /ma mnar sdug bsngal thag bsnar ba sa'i bsnar/ /da dpa' dpa' bo sa spa mdzes pa'i ming*/ /pang rkyang pang pa spangs ri spangs yi spang*/ /da dpang dpang bo par rkyang sku gzugs par/ /sa btags spar ni gnas spar gong du spar/ /da dpangs gyen dpangs sa spangs dor ba'i ming*/ /ra rba chu 'khrugs sa sba mi mngon sba/ /la lba mgul lba 'bubs spra sa btags spra/ /'a 'byed sgo 'byed ga 'gyed khra sogs 'gyed/ /da dmig bu ga ra rmig dud 'gro'i lham/ /dad mod dmod pa sa smod skyon nas smod/ /ra rma lus rma da dma' sa phyogs dma'/ /da dmigs yod pa ra rmi rmi lam rmi/ /da dmar kha dog sa smar mang ba'i don/ /sa smag mun pa da dmag g.yul gyi ming*/ /ra rmos zhing rmo sa smon smon lam 'debs/ /sa sman 'tsho byed da dman ngan pa'o/ /sa sme mi gtsang da dme dme po ste/ /ra rmed sga rmed sa smed dri ba dris/ /ra rtse rtse mo ga gtse gnod pa byed/ /ba ra'i brtse ni snying rjes brtse ba'o/ /ga gtsigs mche gtsigs ba 'og ra brtsigs ni/ /rtsig pa la sogs brtsigs pa'i ming du 'dod/ /ga gtsag gtsag pu ba btsags tshags kyis btsags/ /ba btson btson khang brtson 'grus ba ra'i brtson/ /ra rtsal stobs rtsal ba btsal nor sogs btsal/ /ra rtswa rtsa sngon ba btsa' lcags kyi btsa'/ /ra rtsang sa bdag ga gtsang dri ma bral/ /tsong tsong dbyibs te ba btsong sgog pa'i phyogs/ /ra rtsub reg bya ga gtsub gtsub shing ming*/ /ba btsams gnod byas brtsam bya ba ra'i brtsam/ /ra rtsi rtsi thog ba brtsi brtsi bar bya/ /ba btsod chos yin ra rtsod rgol bar byed/

/ga gtso gtso bo ba btso gser btso ma/ /ma mtsho rgya mtsho 'a 'tsho srog 'tsho ba/ /ma mtshar mdzes pa 'a 'tshar bya ba 'tshar/ /ma mtshal tshon yin 'a 'tshal shes pa'o/ /'a 'tsher 'od 'tsher ma mtsher las la mtsher/ /'a 'dza' chud 'dza' ma mdza' 'dza' mthun ming*/ /'a 'dzad nor 'dzad ma mdzad mdzad pa mdzad/ /'a 'dzad zad pa ma mdzangs ya rabs mdzangs/ /ga gzhes bzhugs pa ba bzhes ja sogs bzhes/ /ga gzhon na tshod ba bzhon bzhon pa'i rta/ /ga gzhog sbo gzhog ba bzhog shing las bzhog /ga gzha' gzha' tshon ba bzha' rlon gyi bzha'/ /ga gzhi gzhi ma ba bzhi grangs kyi ming*/ /ga gzhu gzhu yin ba bzhu mar bzhu ba/ /ga gzhag mnyam gzhag ba bzhag sa la bzhag /ga gzhibs bsgrigs pa ba bzhibs 'jibs pa'i ming*/ /ga gza' gza' skar ba bza' zas bza' ba/ /ba bzas zos zin ga gzas mda' sogs gzas/ /ga gzung gzung bya ba bzung bzung zin ming*/ /ga gzi nor bu ba bzi chang gis bzi/ /ga gzo drin gzo ba bzo gos sogs bzo/ /ga gzod dang po ba bzod bzod pa'i ming*/ /ra rkyang dud 'gro rwa ni mgo yi rwa/ /ga gshog 'dab gshog 'dor shog sha rkyang shog /ga gshags shing gshags ba bshags sdig pa bshags/ /ga gshol thong gshol ba bshol bya ba bshol/ /ba bshar bre dang 'phrang la bshar ba'i ming*/ /shig rkyang lus shig bshig pa ba bshig go /ba bshos zas ming ga gshos chu gshos pa/ /ga gshis gshis lugs gnas tshul sdod lugs yin/ /shul ni rjes shul ba bshul lam gyi ming*/ /sad ni gnyid sad ba bsad srog dang bral/ /sog ni sog pa ga gsog rdzun gyi gsog /sang ni tho rengs sangs pa sgrib sogs sangs/ /ga gsang sbas pa ba bsangs lha yi bsangs/ /ser rkyang kha dog ga gser rin po che/ /ga gsil dum bur ba bsil grang nas bsil/ /song ni phar song ga gsong sbed pa'i ming*/ /ga gsal 'od gsal ba bsal skyon sogs bsal/ /ga gsung dam chos ba bsung dri yi ming*/ /ba bla gong dang tshe bla rung chog sogs/ /sa sla las sla gar ba min pa'i sla/

/ga gla ri dwags rngan pa'i gla rnams yin/ /ba 'og ra brla brla sha ya ma brla/ /ka klu klu yin ga glu skad kyi glu/ /ba blu rin byin sa slu gzhan gyis slu/ /ba sa'i bslus ni bslus zin zhes pa'i tshig /ka klung mtsho sogs ra rlung g.yo ba'i rlung*/ /ra rlangs drod rlangs ba blangs khas blangs sogs/ /ba 'og bslangs pa gyen bslangs slong mo bslangs/ /ka klong dbus yin ba blong yid blong blong*/ /sa slong nor slong skyon brlong ba ra'i brlong*/ /ga glang dud 'gro tshig rtsub ba ra'i brlang*/ /ka klog chos 'don ga glog nam mkha'i glog /za zlog phyir zlog sa slog phyi nang slog / pags pa'i gos te ra rlog med par byed/ /ka klad klad pa ba blad so yis blad/ /sa slad rjes ma skyon bslad ba sa'i bslad/ /ba blo shes pa gla glo glo ba dang*/ /sga yi glo dang lus kyi g.yas g.yon sogs/ /ba blud ja blud ga glud 'dre la gtong*/ /ga glan lhan pa glan dang ra rlan rlon/ /ba 'og sa bslan phyogs su gtogs pa'i bslan/ /ba 'og ra brlan rlan gyis brlan par byas/ /sa sleb gnas phyin ga glebs leb mo glebs/ /ra rlabs chu rlabs byin rlabs byin rlobs shig /ba ra'i brlabs ni byin gyis brlabs par byas/ /ba sa'i bslab ni bslab bya bslabs zin sogs/ /ga gling gling bzhi brtan brling ba ra'i brling*/ /ga glag bya glag ba blags rna ba gtod/ /ba 'og ka bklag dam chos bklag pa'i ming*/ /ba 'og ra brlag thal bar brlag pa'o/ /ra rlubs khung bu ka klubs gos bzang gyon/ /za la la btags zla grogs nam mkha'i zla/ /ma mda' sgro ldan 'a 'da' mya ngan 'da'/ /za zlos bskyar ba ma mdos bon gyi mdos/ /ba bkri khrid pa zho spri sa ba'i spri/ /skrod ni phyir 'ded sprod ni 'thab mo sprod/ /ba sa'i bskrad ni gnas nas phyung ba'o/ /da ka'i dkrugs ni chu sogs dkrugs pa ste/ /sa ba'i sbrug ni gos sogs sprug pa'o/

/ba ka'i bkral ni so sor bkral ba ste/ /das 'phul dpral ni thod kyi dpral ba'o/ kha khrag khong khrag khrag khrig la sogs te/ /pha phrag bcu phrag brgya phrag stong phrag sogs/ kha 'khrul phyin log pha 'phrul rnam par 'phrul/ kha khra bya yin pha phra rtogs par dka'/ kha khru lag khru pha phru rdza yi phru/ kha khral dpon khral pha phral so sor phral/ /ga gro 'bru yin da dro drod kyi ming*/ /ba bro mna' dang gar gyi bye brag ming*/ /ga grang bsil ba da drang drang bo'i drang*/ /ba brang lus mdun da drangs zas drangs zin/ /ga grangs da drangs sa mtha' can dag ni/ /gcig sogs grangs dang gyen nam yar drangs zin/ /da drag drag po ba brag ri yi brag /ga grags sgra grags da drags bya ba thal/ /ba bregs bcad pa da dregs khengs pa'i ming*/ /da dril gcig dril ga gril gos kyis gril/ /da dros mes dros ba bros gzhan du bros/ /ga grongs shi ba da drongs gyen du drongs/ /ga grod grod pa da drod 'od kyi drod/ /ba brod bya ba'i las la bro ba'o/ /ga grub don grub da drub gos drub pa/ /ga gri mtshon cha da dri sna yi yul/ /ba bri kha bri yi ge bri ba'i ming*/ /dong khrus ba brus bzhon drus da yi drus/ /ga grogs grogs mched dam grog sa mtha' med/ /ga 'grub don 'grub da 'drub chos gos 'drub/ /ba brub chu 'khrugs dong du sbas pa'ang yin/ /ga 'gre rigs 'gre da 'dre gnod pa'i 'dre/ /da dred dud 'gro ba bred 'jigs pa'i ming*/ /ga 'grangs lto 'grangs ba 'brangs rjes su 'brangs/ /ga 'grul mgron po da 'drul rul ba'i ming*/ /da 'dri gtam 'dri ba 'bri yi ge 'bri/ /da dris gtam dris ba bris yi ge bris/ /ga 'grel don 'grel ba 'brel rag las 'brel/ /ba 'bros 'jigs 'bros ga 'gros rta yi 'gros/ /ba 'bras 'bru yin ga 'gras zhe 'gras pa/ /ga 'gril 'thur 'gril da 'dril gcig tu 'dril/

/da dgra gnod byed sa sgra mnyan bya'i sgra/ /sa btags ga sgron sgron me'am steng du sgron/ /sa btags ba sbron ra mda' byed par sbron/ /ga sgrib sgrib pa ba sbrid lus sbrid pa/ /ba sa'i bsgrags ni sgra bsgrags byas pa'i ming*/ /sa btags ba sbrags gnyis sbrags sum sbrags sogs/ /ga gcugs mdza' ba bcug nang du bcug /ga gcod shing gcod sgro 'dogs la sogs gcod/ /da 'og pa dpyod gang yin dpyod pa ste/ /sa btags spyod pa bya ba spyod pa'o/ /ba bcad shing bcad da dpyad rtogs pa'i don/ /sa btags spyad pa bya ba byas pa'i ming*/ /ga gcin bshang ba 'byar byed sa btags sbyin/ /chan ni 'bras chan ma mchan yi ge'i mchan/ /'a 'chi srog 'gag ma mchi 'gro ba'i ming*/ /nya nyos nor nyos ma myos chang gis myos/ /ga yi g.yar ni g.yar bo byas pa ste/ /da 'og dbyar ni dus kyi dbyar yin no/ /ga g.yang 'bod pa dpal gyi g.yang yin te/ /da dbyangs yan lag drug cu gsung gi dbyangs/ /des mtshon gzhan dag dpyad de shes par bya/ /de nas sum rtags rtsa 'grel nas 'byung ba'i/ /yi ge'i dbye ba pho mo ma ning dang*/ /ming mtha' rnam dbye tshig phrad la sogs pa/ /cung zad rtogs dka' thor bu 'dir 'chad par/ /spyir na gsal byed thams cad yi ge pho/ /dbyangs yig thams cad mo ru grags pa las/ /ming gzhi'i dbang byas pho mo'i khyad par ni/ /nang gses ka ca ta pa tsa rnams pho/ /ga ja da ba dza wa zha za dang*/ /'a ya sha sa rnams ni mo yin la/ kha cha tha pha tsha rnams ma ning ste/ /nga nya na ma shin tu mo ru 'dod/ /ra la ha rnams mo gsham zhes bya zhing*/ /ma ning mtshan med ces su grags pa yin/ /de las ga nga da na ba ma 'a/ / ra la sa bcu rnams ni rjes 'jug ste/ /ga da ba ma 'a lnga sngon du'ang 'jug / 'di las ba ni sngon 'jug pho yin la/ /ga da gnyis ni ma ning 'a mo ste/ /ma yig sngon 'jug shin tu mo ru 'dod/ /ming gzhi sngon rjes gsum las rang rang gi

/skabs kyi pho mo gang yin gtso bo ste/ /ba ni ming gzhi'i mo yig sngon 'jug pho/ /sa ni rjes 'jug pho yin ming gzhi'i mo/ /rang rang skabs kyi thob tshul shes par bya/ /'on kyang rjes 'jug pho mo ma ning gi/ /ngos 'dzin bzhed tshul mi 'dra 'di lta ste/ /zha lu bas ni da ba sa gsum pho/ /rim bzhin pho la rab 'bring gsum du phye/ /'a mo ra ni mo tsam nyid du bzhed/ /ga nga na gsum 'gyur ba ma ning dang*/ /ma yig mtshan gnyis la ni mtshan med do/ /rnam gling ba sogs mkhas pa du ma yis/ /ga da ba sa bzhi ni rjes 'jug pho/ /nga na ma ra la ni mo yin la/ /'a ni ma ning pho la skyes bu gsum/ /sa ni skyes bu rab yin pa 'bring la/ ga da gnyis ka skyes bu tha mar 'dod/ /ra la gnyis ni mo yin nga na ma/ / shin tu mo 'o 'a ni grogs kyi dbang*/ /ma ning mtshan gnyis mtshan med du 'gyur zhing*/ /bzhed tshul mi 'dra gzhan ni dag kyang yod/ /sngon 'jug pho yig ba ni 'das pa dang*/ /bya ba bsgrub phyir 'jug ste dper mtshon na/ /logs su bkar zin la sogs 'das tshig dang*/ /'brel na 'das pa'i don la 'jug pa ste/ /bya ba ston dang 'brel na gzhan la 'jug /sngon 'jug ma ning ga da gnyis ka ni/ / bdag gam byed pa po la yod pa dang*/ /gzhan nam bya ba gzhi la yod pa dang*/ / da lta bsgrub pa'i ched du 'jug pa ste/ /sngon 'jug mo yig 'a ni ma 'ongs pa/ / ston phyir 'jug cing bdag gzhan la'ang 'jug /sngon 'jug ma yig shin tu mo nyid de/ /bdag gzhan gnyis dang dus gsum mnyam la 'jug /de rnams khyad par sum rtags rtsa 'grel las/ /shes par bya ste 'dir ni mang du dogs/ /sngon rjes ming gzhi gsum ka rang rang gi /pho yig nang 'phrad drag pa'i drag pa ste/ / sngon rjes pho yig ming gzhi mo nyid dang*/ /sngon 'jug ming gzhi drag la rjes 'jug zhan/ /ming gzhi rjes 'jug dran la sngon 'jug zhan/ /sngon 'jug drag la ming rjes gnyis ka zhan/

/sngon 'jug ming gzhi zhan la rjes 'jug drag / sngon rjes zhan la ming gzhi drag pa dang*/ /gsum ka zhan pa nang 'phrad gyur ba la/ /nang gses drag pa'i zhan dang zhan pa'i drag /zhan pa'i zhan pa gnyis su dbye bar gsung*/ /pho yis pho yi ming mtha' 'dren tshul ni/ /ka ca ta pa la sogs ming gzhi phos/ /rjes 'jug da ba sa ga drang bya ste/ /dpyid ka thad ka gyur te gal te dang*/ /thabs cig rgyob cig dag pa la sogs so/ /mo yis mo yi ming mtha' 'dren pa ni/ /byung ba snying ga dgun ka tshor ba sogs/ /ma ning 'a ni pho dang 'phrad na drag /mo 'phrad zhan par 'gyur sogs shes par bya/ /rnam dbye dang po ngo bo brjod pa dang*/ /gnyis pa las su bya dang gsum pa ni/ /byed las yin no bzhi ba dgos ched dang*/ /lnga ba 'byung khungs drug pa 'brel ba dang*/ /bdun pa gnas bzhi brgyad pa bod pa'i sgra/ /de dag ngos 'dzin rgyas par gzhan du shes/ /ming tsam brjod pa rnam dbye dang po ste/ /su du la ru na sogs gnyis pa dang*/ /bzhi pa'am bdun pa nyid du 'gyur ba'ang srid/ /kyis gyis gis yis la sogs gsum pa dang*/ /las nas gnyis ni lnga ba'am dgar tshig ste/ /nas ni mtshams sbyor lhag bcas tshig tu'ang 'gyur/ /kyi gyi gi yi 'i ni drug pa 'brel/ /ming thog kye zhes sbyar ba brgyad pa'o/ /rnam dbye brgyad po de rnams kun la dper/ /lha dang lha dag lha rnams la sogs pa/ /ming tsam gcig tshig dag ni gnyis tshig dang*/ /rnams kun mtha' dag mang tshig nyid du 'gyur/ /ste de te gsum lhag bcas ston pa'i sgra/ /tshigs bcad kha skong nyid la'ang skabs thob 'gyur/ /tshig mtha'i do sogs slar bsdu rdzogs tshig can/ / kyang yang 'ang ni sdud pa'i tshig rgyan te/ /gam dang 'am sogs 'byed sdud dri ba'o/ /ni ni dgar dang bsnan pa'i tshig tu 'dod/ /dang ni 'byed sdud rgyu mtshan tshe skabs dang*/ /gdams ngag lnga la 'jug pa skabs dang sbyor/

/de yig nges bzung 'das pa'i don nyid dang*/ /rnam grangs gzhan dang sbas don sogs la 'jug /su gang ci ni dri ba'am dgag tshig dang*/ /spyi la 'jug cing bye brag go ba'ang srid/ /ba dang can ni pho sgra bdag po ste/ /ldan pa'i don du'ang 'gyur bar shes par bya/ /ma mi med min ming gi thog mthar sbyar/ /phal cher mo sgra dgag pa'i sgra ru 'gyur/ /shin tu kun tu rab tu la sogs pa/ khyad par lhag pa ston pa'i tshig tu 'dod/ /gang ci la sogs phrad ni re re ste/ /gang la ci la sogs pa phrad gnyis 'dus/ /gang gi phyir dang ci yi phyir la sogs/ /'phrad ni mang bo 'dus pa nyid ces bya/ kho na zhes pa nges bzung tshig yin te/ /mi ldan gzhan ldan rnam gcod gnyis su 'gyur/ /nyid ni de dang phyogs 'dra nges bzung tshig /'ba' zhig tsam ni lhag ma 'gog pa ste/ /tsam ni tshad 'dzin nyid du 'gyur ba'ang yin/ /tshul ni 'dra smad sdom pa thabs sogs ston/ /bzhin ni yin dang ma nor 'dra la'ang 'jug /cing dang zhing sogs mtshams sbyor sdud la'o/ /gang phyir de phyir gang tshe de tshe dang*/ /ci phyir de phyir ji ltar de ltar sogs/ /tshig phrad snga phyi 'dren tshul skabs thob sbyar/ /da ba sa gsum rjes su kyi 'thob cing*/ /ga nga gi ste na ma ra la gyi/ /mtha' med 'a mthar 'i dang yi gnyis ni/ /rkang ba skong dang mi skong rnam par dbye/ /ga dang ba yi rjes su tu thob cing*/ /nga da na ma ra la rnams la du/ /da drag tu thob sa yi rjes su su/ /'a dang 'dogs can rkyang ba'i mthar ni ru/ /da de na ra la sa te rkyang la/ /ga nga ba ma 'a dang mtha' med mthar/ /sa ste'o da drag thob pa'i na ra la'i/ /mthar ni te rkyang 'thob 'gyur skabs dang sbyar/ /ga da ba sa da drag thob mthar kyang*/ /'a nga na ma ra la'i rjes su yang*/ /mtha' rten med mthar 'ang dang yang gang rung*/ /ga da ba yi rjes su cing ces dang*/ /ce'o ce na cig thob skabs dang sbyar/ /nga 'a na ma ra la rten med mthar/

/zhing zhes zhe'o zhe na zhig thob bo/ /sa mthar dmigs bsal shes don zhes sbyar te/ /shing zhes she'o she na shig ces bya/ /da drag thob pa'i na ra la gsum rjes/ /cing ces lnga bo sbyor ba dmigs bsal yin/ /ga da na ba ma sa da drag mthar/ /ba dang nga 'a ra la mtha' med dang*/ /rkyang ba'i rjes su ba phyed war 'bod cing*/ /gzhan la pa nyid sbyar ba skabs dang bstun/ / 'dir ni yi ge klog tshul mtshon byas na/ /ka yi gu gu ki dang zhabs kyu ku/ /ka yi 'greng bu ke dang na ro ko /de bzhin yi ge sum cu kun la sbyar/ /ga 'og ca la gca yi zhabs kyu gcu/ /gcu la ga sa gcugs zhes brjod bya ste/ /'on kyang rang rang yul skad bstun pa gtso/ /ga yi 'phul can thog mar rkan nas dbyung*/ /das 'phul lce rtse glod cing ba mas 'phul/ kha yi mchu btsum pa dang khyad par sna/ /'as 'phul gre ba'i phugs nas dbyung bya ste/ /'phul zhing brtsegs pa'i yi ge rnams kyang ni/ /go rim bzhin du dbyung zhes mkhas pas bshad/ /ming tshig yi ge gsum gyi khyad par ni/ /srog med dbyangs gsal thams cad yi ge ste/ /ngo bo brjod tsam phal cher ming yin la/ /ming gnyis phan chad 'dus pa tshig tu 'dod/ /yi ge la ni dngos dang btags pa gnyis/ / dngos ni skad kyi gdangs su brjod pa ste/ /ngo bo sgra yin dbyangs dang gsal byed gnyis/ /ngag gi rjod pa kun la'ang yi ge 'byung*/ /btags pa'i yi ge gzugs su bris pa ste/ /yi ge dngos min de ru grags pa tsam/ /dbye na rgya gar yi ge lnga bcu dang*/ /bod kyi yi ge sum cur grags pa ste/ /tshangs pa'i yi ge la sogs drug cu bzhi/ /rgyas par yig rigs sum brgya drug cu'am/ /de las mang ba nyid du'ang brjod par nus/ /ming la dngos dang btags ming rnam gnyis te/ /gang la thog mar 'dod rgyal brda sbyar ba/ /de yi dngos ming yin te rjes grub tu/ /'dra 'brel rgyu mtshan byas nas brda sbyar ba/

/de yi btags ming nyid du 'gyur ba yin/ /ming ni du ma 'dus las tshig yin te/ /de la gcig tshig gnyis tshig mang tshig gsum/ /rjod byed kun kyang tshig tu 'dod pa'ang yod/ /mdor na yi ge 'dus las ming 'byung zhing*/ /ming las tshig tu 'grub ste de las ni/ /skye 'phags kun gyi tshig gi phung bo dang*/ /gsung rab po ti la sogs 'grub pa yin/ /brjod 'dod dbang gis yi ge ming tshig 'byung*/ /tshig gis don ston de yang tha snyad dang*/ /brda sbyar goms pa'i dbang gis go 'gyur gyi/ /dngos po'i dbang gis min te rnam 'grel las/ /sgra rnams kyis ni brdar btags ston pa dang*/ /de ni tha snyad ched du byas zhes gsungs/ /gal te dngos po'i dbang gis go byed na/ /brda 'brel byed la mi ltos thal 'gyur te/ /gang phyir brda don mi shes byis pas kyang*/ /lto ldir mthong tsam nyid nas bum pa'o/ /snyam pa skye bar 'gyur na de ma mthong*/ /de phyir tshig gis don ston brda la ltos/ /brda yang mkhas pa dag gis mdzad pa'am/ /rang rang yul skad 'dod pa'i dbang gis bzhag /de dag mtshon tsam lde mig lta bu ste/ /rgyas par dam pa'i legs bshad gzhan nas longs/ /zhes dag yig blo gsar gzhon nu dga' byed ces bya ba 'di ni don gnyer can 'ga' zhig gis bskul ba'i ngor shākya'i dge slong bshad sgrub ming can gyis sbyar ba'i yi ge ba ni kun dga' nor bu'o/ /bkra shis// //
mes po'i shul bzhag las/ co ne grags pa bshad sgrub kyi gsung 'bum/ dag yig blo gsar gzhon nu dga' byed bzhugs/ - PAGE 308-- PAGE 307-- PAGE 293-
